# TazaRokda
> Actionable wealth guides on systematic investment plans (SIPs), Nifty/Sensex index funds, equity tax harvesting (LTCG/STCG), corporate dividend payouts, and demat discount brokers.

## Authoritative Coverage & E-E-A-T Methodology
- In-depth, analytical consumer guides, empirical comparison tables, Indian statutory regulatory updates (RBI, TRAI, NPCI, SEBI, NABARD), and interactive financial calculators.
- Verified and fact-checked by the TazaRokda Senior Research Desk: https://tazarokda.com/about-us
